notes: Campaigns now last 50 waves. Foes toughen more gently so the whole run stays winnable, bosses come in pairs from wave 20 and threes from wave 35, and XP and embers per wave are rebalanced for the longer runs.

Camp upgrades go deeper and cost much more. Most now have twice as many levels, each worth half as much, so the caps are the same (Kindling is 16 levels of +10 gold, still 160 in all). Levels you already bought were doubled to match, so you keep every bonus.
Tap the i in a lantern’s upgrade panel during a run for a full guide: how it works, what it’s strong and weak against, a tip, its current numbers, every upgrade on both paths and its ascensions.
Difficulty is now a slider on the Play page.
Embers always show in ember orange, whatever world or theme you have on.
